privacyPolicy.intro1: Barkat-Stein LLC (Barkat-Stein) is committed to protecting your privacy. We want your experience on the Internet to be as pleasant and useful as possible, and we want you to feel completely comfortable using the wide range of information, tools, and opportunities that the Internet offers.
privacyPolicy.intro2: Personal information collected from customers during registration and completion of the feedback form on the website barkat-3d-ville.com, during event registration, when receiving our materials (or at any other time) is primarily used to prepare products or services according to your needs. Your information will not be transferred or sold to third parties.
privacyPolicy.section1_heading: What data is collected on the website
privacyPolicy.section1_text: When you voluntarily register to receive our newsletter and product materials, you submit your data through the registration/feedback form.
privacyPolicy.section2_heading: For what purpose this data is collected
privacyPolicy.section2_text: Your name is used to address you personally, your e-mail is used to send you newsletters, news, useful materials, and commercial offers. Your data is not transferred to third parties under any circumstances, except in cases related to compliance with legal requirements. Your data is stored on Barkat-Stein's secure servers and is used in accordance with its privacy policy. You can unsubscribe from receiving newsletters and delete your contact data from the database at any time by clicking on the unsubscribe link present in each email.
privacyPolicy.section3_text: The website barkat-3d-ville.com uses cookies, data from Yandex Metrika and Google Analytics services. This data is used to collect information about visitor actions on the site in order to improve its content, enhance the site's functionality, and consequently create quality content and services for visitors. You can change your browser settings at any time to block all cookies or notify you when these files are being sent. Please note that some features and services may not work properly.
privacyPolicy.section4_text: To protect your personal information, we use various administrative, managerial, and technical security measures. Our Company adheres to various international control standards aimed at personal information operations, which include certain control measures to protect information collected on the Internet. Our employees are instructed to implement these control measures and are familiar with our Privacy Policy, rules, and instructions. Nevertheless, although we strive to protect your personal information, you must also take measures to protect it. We strongly recommend that you take all possible precautions while on the Internet. The services and websites we organize provide measures to protect against leakage, unauthorized use, and modification of information under our control. Despite our best efforts to ensure the integrity and security of our network and systems, we cannot guarantee that our security measures will prevent illegal access to this information by third-party hackers. In the event of changes to this privacy policy, you will be able to read about these changes on this page or, in special cases, receive a notification to your e-mail. To contact the website administrator regarding any questions, you can write an email to: info@barkat-3d-ville.com

userAgreement.title: PUBLIC CONTRACT (OFFER)
userAgreement.subtitle: for ordering, purchase and sale of goods and services
userAgreement.intro: This contract is an official and public offer from the Seller to conclude a purchase and sale agreement for the Product presented on the website https://barkat-3d-ville.com/uk-UA. This contract is public, meaning that in accordance with Article 633 of the Civil Code of Ukraine, its terms are the same for all buyers regardless of their status (individual, legal entity, individual entrepreneur) without giving preference to one buyer over another. By entering into this Agreement, the buyer fully accepts the terms and procedure for placing an order, payment for goods, delivery of goods, return of goods, liability for dishonest orders, and all other terms of the agreement. The Agreement is considered concluded from the moment of clicking the "Confirm Order" button on the order confirmation page in the "Cart" Section and the Buyer's receipt of order confirmation from the Seller in electronic form.

section1.title: 1. Definition of terms
section1.item1_1: 1.1. Public Offer (hereinafter - "Offer") - a public proposal from the Seller, addressed to an indefinite circle of persons, to conclude a remote purchase and sale agreement for goods with the Seller (hereinafter - "Agreement") on the terms contained in this Offer.
section1.item1_2: 1.2. Product or Service – the subject of the parties' transaction, which was selected by the buyer on the Online Store website and placed in the cart, or already purchased by the Buyer from the Seller remotely.
section1.item1_3: 1.2. Online Store – the Seller's website at https://barkat-3d-ville.com/uk-UA/soft#SketchUp created for concluding retail and wholesale purchase and sale agreements based on the Buyer's familiarization with the Product description offered by the Seller via the Internet.
section1.item1_4: 1.3. Buyer – a legally capable individual who has reached 18 years of age, receives information from the Seller, places an order for the purchase of goods presented on the Online Store website for purposes not related to conducting business activities, or a legal entity or individual entrepreneur.
section1.item1_5: 1.4. Seller – Limited Liability Company "Barkat-Stein LLC" (identification code 43398783), a legal entity created and operating in accordance with the current legislation of Ukraine, location: Kyiv region, Obukhiv, Kyivska street, building 170, apt. 138

section2.title: 2. Subject of the Agreement
section2.item2_1: 2.1. The Seller undertakes to transfer ownership of the Product to the Buyer, and the Buyer undertakes to pay for and accept the Product under the terms of this Agreement.
section2.item2_2: 2.2. The date of conclusion of the Offer Agreement (acceptance of the offer) and the moment of full and unconditional acceptance by the Buyer of the Agreement's terms is considered to be the date when the Buyer fills out the order form located on the Online Store website, subject to the Buyer's receipt of order confirmation from the Seller in electronic form. If necessary, at the Buyer's request, the Agreement may be executed in written form.

section3.title: 3. Order Placement
section3.item3_1: 3.1. The Buyer independently places an order in the Online Store through the "Cart" form, or by placing an order via email.
section3.item3_2: 3.2. The Seller has the right to refuse to transfer the order to the Buyer if the information provided by the Buyer when placing the order is incomplete or raises doubts about its authenticity.
section3.item3_3: 3.3. When placing an order on the Online Store website, the Buyer undertakes to provide the following mandatory information necessary for the Seller to fulfill the order:
section3.item3_3_1: 3.3.1. last name, first name of the Buyer;
section3.item3_3_3: 3.3.3. Identification code for a legal entity or individual entrepreneur.
section3.item3_4: 3.4. The name, quantity, article number, price of the Product selected by the Buyer are indicated in the Buyer's cart on the Online Store website.
section3.item3_5: 3.5. If either Party to the agreement needs additional information, they have the right to request it from the other Party. In case of failure to provide necessary information by the Buyer, the Seller is not responsible for providing quality service to the Buyer when purchasing goods in the online store.
section3.item3_6: 3.6. When placing an order through the Seller's operator (clause 3.1. of this Offer), the Buyer undertakes to provide the information specified in clauses 3.3 – 3.4. of this Offer.
section3.item3_7: 3.6. The Buyer's acceptance of the terms of this Offer is carried out by the Buyer entering the relevant data in the registration form on the Online Store website or when placing an Order through a manager. After placing an Order through a Manager, the Buyer's data is entered into the Seller's database.
section3.item3_8: 3.7. The Buyer is responsible for the accuracy of the information provided when placing an Order.
section3.item3_9: 3.8. By entering into the Agreement, that is, by accepting the terms of this offer (the proposed terms for purchasing the Product), by placing an Order, the Buyer confirms the following:
section3.item3_9_a: a) The Buyer has fully and completely familiarized themselves with and agrees to the terms of this offer;
section3.item3_9_b: b) they give permission for the collection, processing, and transfer of personal data; permission for the processing of personal data is valid for the entire term of the Agreement, as well as for an unlimited period after its expiration. In addition, by entering into the agreement, the Buyer confirms that they have been notified (without additional notification) of the rights established by the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection," of the purposes of data collection, and that their personal data is transferred to the Seller for the purpose of fulfilling the terms of this Agreement, conducting mutual settlements, and receiving invoices, acts, and other documents. The Buyer also agrees that the Seller has the right to provide access to and transfer their personal data to third parties without any additional notifications to the Buyer for the purpose of fulfilling the Buyer's order. The scope of the Buyer's rights as a personal data subject in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" is known and understood by them.

section4.title: 4. Price of services
section4.item4_1: 4.1 Prices for Products and services are determined by the Seller independently and are indicated on the Online Store website. All prices for Products and services are indicated on the website in hryvnias including VAT.
section4.item4_2: 4.2 Prices for Products and services may be changed by the Seller unilaterally depending on market conditions. However, the price of a separate unit of Product, the cost of which has been paid by the Buyer in full, cannot be changed by the Seller unilaterally.
section4.item4_6: 4.6. The Buyer's obligations to pay for the Product are considered fulfilled from the moment the Seller receives funds into their account.
section4.item4_7: 4.7. Settlements between the Seller and the Buyer for the Product are carried out by the methods specified on the website.

section5.title: 5. Rights and obligations of the Parties
section5.item5_1_1: 5.1.1. Transfer the product to the Buyer in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Buyer's order.
section5.item5_1_2: 5.1.2. Not disclose any private information about the Buyer and not provide access to this information to third parties, except in cases provided for by law and when fulfilling the Buyer's Order.
section5.item5_2: 5.2. The Seller has the right to:
section5.item5_2_1: 5.2.1 Change the terms of this Agreement, as well as prices for Products and services, unilaterally, by posting them on the Online Store website. All changes take effect from the moment of their publication.
section5.item5_3_1: 5.3.1 Before entering into the Agreement, familiarize themselves with the content of the Agreement, the terms of the Agreement, and the prices offered by the Seller on the Online Store website.
section5.item5_3_2: 5.3.2 For the Seller to fulfill their obligations to the Buyer, the latter must provide all necessary data that uniquely identify them as the Buyer and are sufficient for the delivery of the ordered Product to the Buyer.

section6.title: 6. Returns
section6.item6_1: 6.1. Refunds are possible if the purchased software or online service does not function properly (an error has been found that cannot be corrected).
section6.item6_2: 6.2. Buyers have access to free trial versions of all products, as well as a free account in online services, the functionality and capabilities of which can be evaluated before placing an order.
section6.item6_3: 6.3. Refund requests are not accepted for consideration if received after the expiration of 30 calendar days from the date of payment.
section6.item6_4: 6.4. A written refund request with reasons for refusing the product (description of errors found) must be sent no later than 30 calendar days from the date of payment to order@barkat-3d-ville.com.
section6.item6_5: 6.5. The Seller reserves the right to carefully review each refund request for up to 14 days.
section6.item6_6: 6.6. Refunds may take up to 21 business days.

section7.title: 7. Liability of the parties
section7.item7_1: 7.1. The Seller is not liable for damage caused to the Buyer or third parties as a result of improper use of the software.
section7.item7_2: 7.2. The Seller is not liable for improper, untimely fulfillment of Orders and their obligations in case the Buyer provides inaccurate or erroneous information.
section7.item7_3: 7.3. The Seller and the Buyer are liable for the fulfillment of their obligations in accordance with the current legislation of Ukraine and the provisions of this Agreement.
section7.item7_4: 7.4. The Seller or the Buyer are released from liability for complete or partial non-fulfillment of their obligations if the non-fulfillment is a consequence of force majeure circumstances such as: war or military actions, earthquake, flood, fire and other natural disasters that arose independently of the will of the Seller and/or Buyer after the conclusion of this agreement. The Party that cannot fulfill its obligations immediately notifies the other Party.

section8.title: 8. Confidentiality and protection of personal data.
section8.item8_1: 8.1. By providing their personal data on the Online Store website during registration or when placing an Order, the Buyer gives the Seller their voluntary consent to the processing, use (including transfer) of their personal data, as well as the performance of other actions provided for by the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection," without limitation of the term of such consent.
section8.item8_2: 8.2. The Seller undertakes not to disclose information received from the Buyer. It is not considered a violation for the Seller to provide information to counterparties and third parties acting on the basis of an agreement with the Seller, including for the fulfillment of obligations to the Buyer, as well as in cases where the disclosure of such information is established by the requirements of the current legislation of Ukraine.
section8.item8_3: 8.3. The Buyer is responsible for maintaining their personal data in an up-to-date state. The Seller is not responsible for poor quality performance or non-performance of their obligations due to the outdated nature of information about the Buyer or its inconsistency with reality.

section9.title: 9. Other conditions
section9.item9_1: 9.1. This agreement is concluded on the territory of Ukraine and is valid in accordance with the current legislation of Ukraine.
section9.item9_2: 9.2. All disputes arising between the Buyer and the Seller are resolved through negotiations. In case of failure to reach a settlement of a disputed issue through negotiations, the Buyer and/or Seller have the right to apply to judicial authorities for dispute resolution in accordance with the current legislation of Ukraine.
section9.item9_3: 9.3. The Seller has the right to make changes to this Agreement unilaterally, as provided in clause 5.2.1. of the Agreement. In addition, changes to the Agreement may also be made by mutual consent of the Parties in the manner provided for by the current legislation of Ukraine.
